definitions.explanation: A reservation made on the same day it is to be used, as opposed to booking in advance. Common for restaurants, hotels, medical appointments, and event tickets.

examples.japanese: {当日予約|とうじつよやく}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦できます→できる：00557_dekiru⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: Can I make a same-day reservation?

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{旅館|りょかん}→旅館：01049_ryokan⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{当日予約|とうじつよやく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}け{付|つ}けていない→受け付ける：05683_uketsukeru⟧。
examples.english: This inn doesn't accept same-day reservations.

examples.japanese: ⟦{人気|にんき}→人気：01488_ninki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦レストラン→レストラン：01048_resutoran⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{当日予約|とうじつよやく}だ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{席|せき}→席：02215_seki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{取|と}れない→取れる：02376_toreru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: At popular restaurants, you often can't get a table with a same-day reservation.

notes:
Combines ⟦{当日|とうじつ}→当日：04558_toujitsu⟧ (that day, the day itself) and ⟦{予約|よやく}→予約：01522_yoyaku⟧ (reservation). A practical compound used frequently in daily life, travel, and service industries.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {当日予約|とうじつよやく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{可能|かのう}→可能：00175_kanou⟧: same-day reservation possible
- {当日予約|とうじつよやく}⟦{不可|ふか}→不可：01922_fuka⟧: no same-day reservations
- {当日予約|とうじつよやく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}け{付|つ}ける→受け付ける：05683_uketsukeru⟧: to accept same-day reservations
- {当日予約|とうじつよやく}⟦{割引|わりびき}→割引：01526_waribiki⟧: same-day booking discount

CONTRASTING TERMS:
- ⟦{事前予約|じぜんよやく}→事前予約：22770_jizenyoyaku⟧: advance reservation — booking made ahead of time
- {前日予約|ぜんじつよやく}: day-before reservation — booking made one day prior
- ⟦{飛|と}び{込|こ}み→飛び込み：07114_tobikomi⟧: walk-in — arriving without any reservation at all
